name: GM - Factory ZERO (Detroit-Hamtramck Assembly), Detroit MI

fieldNotes.facility: GM Factory ZERO (Detroit-Hamtramck Assembly), 2500 E Grand Blvd / E General Motors Blvd, Detroit MI 48211. GM's $2.2B EV plant (3.5M sq ft) building GMC Hummer EV, Cadillac Escalade IQ, Chevrolet Silverado EV and GMC Sierra EV. Geocode for the street address landed near the residential SE edge; web-confirmed and re-pinned on the large light-roofed assembly complex centered ~42.3805,-83.0475. Site is a rounded ~380-acre parcel bounded by a multi-track rail corridor on the N/NW, the I-94 (Edsel Ford) freeway on the S, and St Aubin / industrial streets on the E.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Secured GM assembly campus with continuous perimeter fencing (Street View shows chain-link with concrete jersey-barrier base along the NE industrial street, dock doors behind). Truck access is via controlled internal roads off the perimeter ring rather than directly from a public street; the main staffed entrances are set back inside the buffer. Multiple controlled access drives (NW dock approach and E/NE yard approach) - entry and exit run from separate points of the property line. Verdict: truckGate true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: GM assembly plants of this scale uniformly run staffed security gatehouses at controlled entrances. The public roads encircling the campus (rail corridor N, freeway S, buffer/embankment W) do not give a clean frontal Street View of the interior guard gate, so the booth could not be crisply isolated - marked uncertain, but guardShack true is the high-confidence call for a $2.2B secured assembly plant.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Distinct controlled access drives at different points of the perimeter - a NW approach serving the west dock/material face and a NE/E approach serving the rail-served yard and finished-vehicle lots.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved internal aprons and holding lanes inside the perimeter ahead of the dock faces provide queue space for inbound material trailers.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal perimeter and approach roads are long and deep - easily hold a 3+ truck queue between the property line and the dock faces.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane internal driveways and oversized paved aprons on the west and east faces leave unused width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted ~45 loading doors across the west material-receiving face and the east dock banks / supplier building - estimate from overhead imagery, marked uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Material receiving / inbound docks cluster on the west building face (dock aprons + retention-pond side); finished-vehicle outbound staging and the trailer/rail yard are on the east - physically separate shipping and receiving clusters.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Multiple rows of dry-van / drop trailers parked in the east yard (z18 imagery shows dozens of trailers backed against dock structures and staged in rows), plus a rail-served trailer area on the NE - dedicated trailer storage separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ trailers visible across the east drop-trailer rows and rail-served NE yard.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: East yard and NE rail-served area could hold ~180 trailers; the same paved acreage also stages finished EVs, so capacity is shared - approximate.
fieldNotes.railServed: Active multi-track rail corridor (Conrail/CN) runs the full N/NW boundary with loaded railcars visible in Street View; rail spur tracks run down into the E side of the property (z17 NE view) - rail served true.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multiple large building clusters on one fenced property - the main assembly complex plus a separate body-shop / supplier building cluster on the NE and the battery/EV shops - a campus.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Outer controlled perimeter access plus internal vehicle-control checkpoints typical of an assembly plant of this scale and security level.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the dense Detroit/Hamtramck urban fabric - surrounded by residential blocks, industrial streets, and freeway - Urban.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly isolated in the imagery; left uncertain.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter polygon yields ~380 acres including the rail/freeway buffer; documented historical site is ~365 acres - honest overhead estimate.

citations.claim: GM lists Factory ZERO (Detroit-Hamtramck Assembly), Detroit MI as a GM-operated EV assembly plant building GMC Hummer EV / Sierra EV, Chevrolet Silverado EV, Cadillac Escalade IQ
GM PR confirms $2.2B conversion of Detroit-Hamtramck into Factory ZERO, GM's flagship EV assembly plant

verification.rationale: GM-owned/operated EV assembly plant, currently producing; the Mar-Apr 2026 production pause is a planned recalibration, not closure. Detroit-Hamtramck was kept by New GM in 2009 (not divested to Motors Liquidation/RACER).
